one of the ‘Collins grandchildren’, probably a granddaughter of George and Martha Collins.

She may be the person referred to in F.D.

How, \'The late Miss Charlotte M.

Yonge: An Interview\' Sunday Magazine (June 1901) 437-439: \'There was a keen satisfaction in the tone in which she said, \"The little maid who let you in is a link with old times.

Her grandfather was in the service of our family for sixty years.\"\' This would be [George Collins](/person/357).
